messages:
tasha (AE): Quick sync: FinServCo POC—they want to validate transaction-classification using LLM. Main blockers: data residency (EU), security questionnaire, and cost predictability. Asking which deployment we recommend for a 2-week POC. Thoughts?

sam (SE): If they require EU-only data + SLA, Dedicated in eu-west is simplest. Hosted can work if they accept our eu region only + contract addendum for data handling. Private only if they need on-prem or full network isolation.

ken (Solutions Eng): For POC I'd try Hosted eu-west with customer-managed keys (KMS) + IP allowlist. Low friction. We can do Dedicated if throughput > 200 req/s or need strict latency SLO.

tasha (AE): They asked about cost. What's rough POC pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated? Need a number to include in SOW.

sam (SE): Hosted POC: usage-based, estimate ~ $1.2k - $2.5k for 2 weeks depending on token volume. Dedicated trial: small reserved capacity—min $12k/month pro-rated for 2 weeks. Private: varies, start ~$50k setup + license.

maria (Prod PM): Add success criteria: 1) classification accuracy >= 92% on their gold set, 2) 95th pctl latency < 250ms for typical 512-token request, 3) monthlyized token cost < $0.0009/token equivalent. Also need integration eval: end-to-end test harness with 500 sample prompts.

ken (Solutions Eng): I'll draft eval prompts. Example prompt:
```
Classify the following transaction into categories: 'TRANSFER_INTERNATIONAL; amount: 2,350 EUR; description: salary'
```
We'll run batch eval in Redwood Console and collect F1/precision/recall.

ops (Infra): If we pick Hosted eu-west, we need to confirm model is available in region (e.g., redwood/opt-13b-q4) and that prefix caching is enabled. I'll check capacity and ping infra.

security-bot: Checklist: SOC2? Yes. Data residency: require Data Processing Addendum + EU Data Processing Agreement. BYOK available. Need completion of standard security questionnaire v2. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/q2

tasha (AE): Customer wants timeline: start next Monday, 10 business days total. Can we commit?

ken (Solutions Eng): We can start onboarding+eval pipeline day 1, model tuning/ops day 2-6, run gold-set eval day 7-9, wrap/report day 10. Need their gold labels and access to sample logs by Friday.

sam (SE): @tasha I'll prepare Hosted eu-west config & pricing note. If FinServCo signs enterprise NDA + DPA, Hosted should be fine and much faster. If legal pushes for on-prem, we'll loop in sales execs.

tasha (AE): :thumbsup: I'll reply to customer with two options (Hosted eu-west w/ BYOK and Dedicated eu-west) and include success criteria + SOW numbers. Thanks all.
